An anxious mother in Slitherbough relates to you her plight. As she tells it, her son Valan─who you had some dealings with in the past─has once again run off with Quinfort, a would-be prophet with a penchant for the dramatic. She bids you go in search for the young man, lest he and his friend wander off too far and get themselves in trouble.

entries.en: Searching the forest, you come upon Quinfort and a visibly frustrated Valan. The latter is expressing his frustration with his friend's predilection for dashing off at a moment's notice with scarcely a word of explanation when─lo and behold─Quinfort is struck with another vision, and promptly dashes off deep into the forest. With an audible sigh, Valan turns to you and asks that you join him in surveying the area for any sign of the impulsive prognosticator.
entries.fr: Quinfort ayant encore une fois pris la poudre d'escampette, vous êtes parti à sa recherche avec Valan. Observez les environs de l'Abîme d'Ox'Dalan pour retrouver sa trace.

entries.en: You succeed in tracking down Quinfort, who stands before a curious scene: two ratlike creatures─one old, one young─being threatened at spearpoint by a couple of Viis guards. The two introduce themselves as Qitarl Natl and Chaqurl Qhotl of the Qitari, a mouselike tribe that once served the empire of Ronka as scribes and scriveners before being driven to the depths of the forest at the time of the Flood. Having emerged from their hundred-year exile, they now seek to unearth the Qitari stelae─massive stone tablets engraved with records of their accumulated knowledge and history, and in doing so reclaim their legacy. They are accompanied by a small, squirmy creature that is the spitting image of the Great Serpent of Ronka who Quinfort so loyally serves. The serpent then dashes off with an excited “scree,” leading the Qitari duo and Quinfort alike to conclude that the divine protector is leading them to the relic they seek. Should you be so inclined, follow along and join them in the search.
entries.fr: Vous avez rencontré une paire de Qitari venus de la forêt à l'est de L'Enchevêtrement. Ce père et son fils sont à la recherche d'une stèle laissée dans la forêt par leurs ancêtres. Retrouvez Chaqurl Qhotl au plateau de Hopl, à l'est de l'Abîme d'Ox'Dalan.
entries.ja: キタンナ神影洞の東の森からやってきたという、キタリ族の親子と話した。親子は、先祖が森に残した、一族の石碑を探しているらしい。オキス・ダランの深淵東で「チャクルリ・コテル」と話そう。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: You find the Qitari and their serpent standing near a sealed cave entrance. It is here, according to Qitarl Natl, that his forefathers stored away the stone tablets for safekeeping before fleeing the forest some one hundred years ago. He further elaborates that breaking the seal will require a relic of ancient Ronka─or more specifically, a stone housing immense aetherial power, and entreats your assistance in searching for one. You resolve to ponder their offer, and to speak with Qitarl again should you be inclined to cooperate.
entries.fr: Vous avez discuté avec vos deux nouveaux amis. Qitarl Natl vous a expliqué comment ils se sont retrouvés isolés des autres peuples de la forêt et ce qui a motivé leur retour. Parlez-lui si vous avez décidé d'aider les Qitari dans leur quête.
entries.ja: チャクルリ・コテルと話した。キタリ族たちを手伝っていくかどうか「キタルリ・ナトル」と話そう。
entries.section: Allied Society Quests (A Realm Reborn through Endwalker)

entries.en: Qitarl rejoices at your generous offer of aid, his long-held wish of reclaiming his tribe's legacy finally within reach. Quinfort, struck with another burst of possibly divine inspiration, offers his hypothesis that the striped pattern on the great serpent's body might indeed be a clue as to the location of the stone you seek. Questioning his sanity but having nowhere else to turn, you strike out in search of the ancient relic that may grant you and your newfound Qitari friends passage into the cavern.
entries.fr: Qitarl Natl vous a expliqué qu'il lui fallait un objet appelé éclat de Ronka afin de lever le sceau qui bloque l'entrée de la caverne de ses ancêtres. Quinfort est intervenu pour expliquer sa théorie :  cet éclat désigne sûrement un point de convergence des courants éthérés. Allez donc inspecter le lieu que vous a indiqué Quinfort puis donnez votre trouvaille à Chaqurl Qhotl.
entries.ja: キタルリ・ナトルと話した。洞窟遺跡の入口を開くため、森を巡ってロンカの輝石を探すこととなった。キンフォートの言う地脈の結節点付近で必要なものを入手し、「チャクルリ・コテル」に納品しよう。

entries.en: You succeed in finding the stone and delivering it safely to Chaqurl Qhotl. Quinfort's ramblings again prove remarkably prophetic when the engraved slab sealing the cave's entrance gives way, granting passage to the grottoes and tunnels within. The Qitari explorers jump for joy, unable to contain their excitement at the discoveries that doubtless lie ahead. They resolve to call for a select group of their fellow tribesmen to assist in the excavation effort, which will be conducted on a grand scale. Should you be of a mind to aid the self-styled Stewards of Note in pursuing their life's work, they will surely welcome your continued presence at their camp in Hopl's Stopple.
entries.fr: Vos efforts ont porté leurs fruits et le sceau à l'entrée de la caverne a été levé. Les Qitari ont désormais installé un campement afin de l'explorer. Les grandes créatures à fourrure comptent sur vos futures contributions pour permettre de déterrer les trésors enfouis sous terre.
entries.ja: ロンカの輝石となるものをキタルリ・ナトルに納品した。輝石の力によって洞窟遺跡の入口が開き、ルリの発掘隊によってホパル古盤に拠点が整えられた。引き続き協力し、キタリ族たちの石碑の発掘を助けよう。

entries.en: The Qitari? That is a name I have heard from my elders. And yet, I was told that the last Qitari vanished a hundred years ago.
entries.fr: Qitari... J'ai déjà entendu ce nom de la bouche des anciens du village. C'était un peuple vivant dans la forêt depuis l'époque de Ronka, mais qui aurait disparu il y a cent ans.
entries.ja:
キタリ族だと……？
その名ならば、里の先達に聞いたことがある。
古代ロンカの時代より森に住み、100年前に姿を消した民だと。

entries.en: Those of us born after the Flood never paid the stories much heed, but... You say that we truly stand before a Qitari in the flesh?
entries.fr: Nombre d'entre nous étant nées après le déluge de Lumière, nous n'avons jamais rencontré un de ces fameux Qitari.
entries.ja:
我らは、里でも「光の氾濫」後の生まれであるから、
その姿を見たことはなかったが、まさか……。

entries.ja:
それがしは、キタリ族はルリの氏族、
キタルリ・ナトルと申す者。
これに控えるは、のチャクルリ・コテルにござる。

entries.en: For nigh on a century, our tribe has made its home in the shadow of the Light─deep in the forests on the far side of Qitana Ravel, by the rushing waters of Rak'tika Falls.
entries.fr: Depuis cent ans, Qitari peur du brille brille. Alors cachés dans grande forêt derrière Enchevêtrement et chuuutes de Rak'tika !
entries.ja:
この100年、我らキタリ族は、キタンナ神影洞の向こう……
ラケティカ大飛瀑方面に広がる森で、
白き光の精から、身を隠し暮らして参った。

entries.en: We did not always hide in the darkness─this place we now stand was once our home. Then came that fateful day when the skies were flooded with Light. Facing certain doom, our forebears fled the forests─but not before a band of the bravest gave their lives to store away our greatest treasures for safekeeping, with the hope that one day their children's children might unearth them anew.
entries.fr: Mais anciens Qitari raconter vivre ici jadis. Quand brille brille approcher de forêt, anciens cacher trésor ici et fuuuir loin...
entries.ja:
だが、我が氏族は古来、こちらの森に住まっていたと伝え聞く。
そして、空に光溢れしとき、先祖伝来の宝を森に秘して、
子孫への継承を神に託し、追われるままその地をあとにしたと……。

entries.fr: Chaqurl Qhotl vouloir chercher trésor, chercher stèle des Qitari. Belle sculptuuure symbolisant histoire et sagesse des Qitari !

その宝こそが、チャクルリが探しに来たと申した、
一族の小史と知恵が刻まれし「キタリの石碑」なのでござる。

entries.en: Of course! It is precisely as I saw it in the visions the great serpent bestowed upon me! A proud and ancient tribe of scribes and scholars! The stewards of knowledge of ancient Ronka!
entries.fr: Ooooh !! C'est exactement ce que m'a montré le Destructeur ! Un peuple ancien de Ronka, héritier de l'illustre sagesse millénaire.
entries.ja:
おお、おおッ！
ロンカの古き民にして、叡智の継承者たちよ！
ボクが水蛇様に授けられしビジョンで、視たとおりではないか！！

entries.en: ...Oho. You are most insightful, my friend. Indeed, we were once known as the Stewards of Note─a title that fittingly describes both our duties as keepers of written knowledge, and the surpassing aptitude with which we pursued the task. Our ancestors served proudly as scribes and scriveners for many a generation of Ronkan emperors.
entries.fr: Héritier de la sagesse... Ho ho, quel joli nom, ami ! Mais Qitari être simple tribuuu de scribes, serviteurs de l'empereur Ronka.
entries.ja:
叡智の継承者とは……ほっほ、かたじけなき呼び名でござりますな！
しかし……いかにもキタリ族は、書記官の一族として、
ロンカ皇帝にお仕え申したもの。

entries.en: It is a role that came quite naturally to our people. For you see, we are not blessed with the longer lifespans of your kind. Thus, from our earliest days, we have been most meticulous about recording the happenings and learnings of our lives in precise and painstaking detail.
entries.fr: Qitari vivre beaucouuup moins longtemps que autres peuples de Ronka. Alors devoir inscrire histoire et connaissances de tribu pour transmettre à descendance.
entries.ja:
我らは、伝え聞く他の種族に比べ、寿命を迎えるのが早うござる。
それゆえ、歴史をくまなく刻み記すことで、
次の世代に、一族の知識と記憶を継承してきたのですな。

entries.en: The Qitari stelae─or, more specifically, the carvings and etchings that grace their surfaces─represent the summation of all the knowledge and wisdom we have acquired over the years. They represent, one might say, the collective memory of our people, passed down through the ages from generation to generation.
entries.fr: Anciens Qitari très snif snif quand partir de forêt sans stèle. Anciens avoir peur d'ouuublier histoire de tribu.
entries.ja:
一族の霊宝である石碑とは、まさにご先祖様が残し、
受け継いできた、大切な記憶の標石なのでござる。

entries.en: Long have we dreamed of returning here to search for the stones, and reclaiming our legacy. And yet! Nasty, nasty sin eaters and worse stood in our path, making the journey far too pair-lious to even attempt!

いつか「キタリの石碑」を探しにいけたらいいなって、
そるかし、いつも夢見てたでござうよ。
でも、塞がれた森からは出られないって……そしたら！

entries.en: Then, one day, the skies turned dark! I trembled in terror, but next thing I knew, the great serpent was hopping and squirming beside me! He told me that a path through the Ravel had been cleared, and we were free to go home at last!
entries.fr: Et puis, brille brille dans ciel disparaître touuut à coup. Chaqurl voir nuit pour première fois ! Puis Serpent marin apparaître devant Chaqurl et montrer possible traverser Enchevêtrement pour rejoindre forêt des anciens.
entries.ja:
いきなりお空が暗～くなって、一族みんな驚いていたでござう。
そのとき、チャクルリのところに水蛇様が現れて……
キタンナ神影洞に道が通じたことを、教えてくださったでござう！

entries.en: Precisely. And so it was that my boy and I received the blessings of our fellow Qitari, and became the first of our kind in generations to return to this part of the Greatwood. Unfortunately, we were immediately set upon by all sorts of nasty creatures, forcing us to retreat and ponder our course of action.
entries.fr: Qitarl Natl partir avec fils pour chercher stèle cachée dans ancienne grotte. Mais forêt être remplie de monstres, Qitari pas pouuuvoir aller loin...
entries.ja:
うむ、そうして仲間たちから先行し、
親子ふたり、石碑の隠された洞窟遺跡を、探しに参ったでござる。
しかし魔物も多く、立ち往生していたところ……

entries.en: ...Where we came upon you, and threatened you at spearpoint. Pray forgive us, allies of Ronka. We knew not who you were, nor all you had suffered to arrive here.
entries.fr: Pardonnez notre comportement... Si nous avions su que vous étiez aussi un des peuples de Ronka, nous n'aurions jamais pointé nos lances sur vous.
entries.ja:
我らが駆けつけ、そなたらに槍を向けてしまった、と……。
なるほどな、ロンカの同胞に対し、すまないことをした。

entries.en: You intend to remain here in the Greatwood to search for these...stelae of yours, was it? Worry not. We shall tell all in Fanow of you─that you are friends, and not to be harmed. And with that, we must be on our way. Go in peace.
entries.fr: Si vous êtes à la recherche d'une ancienne grotte et d'une stèle, je pense que nous serons amenés à nous recroiser dans cette forêt. Je vais prévenir mes sœurs pour qu'il n'y ait plus aucun malentendu. À bientôt, amis de Ronka...
entries.ja:
洞窟遺跡と石碑を探すなら、しばらくこの森に留まるのだろう？
里の仲間にも、怪しい者たちではないと伝えておこう。
なれば、我らはこれにて……。

entries.en: Dear me, but that was a close one, wasn't it? I was all but certain Chaqurl and I were going to end up skewered. Were it up to me, I would have left the boy behind for his safety. But he is ever a curious one, and would hear nothing of it.
entries.fr: Pfiou... Qitarl Natl imaginer Chaqurl en brochette sur lances des amies aux grandes oreilles. Forêt cacher beaucoup de dangers, et Qitarl Natl vouloir explorer seul... Mais jeune Qitari trop cuuurieux pour rester à maison.
entries.ja:
ふぅ……やれやれ、一時はチャクルリともども串刺しにされるかと。
どんな危険が待つかわからぬと、置いてくるつもりでござったが、
倅は好奇心旺盛で、ついていくと言って聞かなんだ。

チャクルリは、もう立派な3歳でござうよ！

ときに、お主たちはこの森に詳しゅうござるか？
口伝では、石碑が隠された洞窟遺跡は、
オキス・ダランの深淵に沿った崖上の地であるとのこと……。

entries.en: Do allow me to explain. We Qitari worship Ox'Dalan, god of the dead and the world below. Our forebears no doubt believed that if they sealed away the stelae deep within the bowels of the land, Dalan Himself would watch over them and keep them safe until the day their descendants returned.

entries.en: Hark unto the serpent's cry! And know that the points of light that glow amidst the stripes represent those precise spots where the aether that flows through the Greatwood is most densely concentrated!
entries.fr: Voyez cette marque brillante au-dessus de ses majestueuses rayures ! Elle ne peut que désigner l'endroit où s'accumule la toute-puissance de la forêt, autrement dit un point de convergence des courants éthérés. Je pense que c'est ce que l'éclat de Ronka désigne !
entries.ja:
縞模様の上に、不思議な輝きを帯びた部分があるのがその証拠だ。
示されるは「森の力」の集積地と呼べる場所……
そこで輝石は、森が産み落としたかの如く見つかるに違いない！
